subject: exp-dym
title: EXP.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in WAC-27, the first of three on book p229. EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality). Embedded in the Euro-American discussion. EXP-DYM outputs to SOC-RT (the crossing), POL-DYM (political dynamics), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). ACC-FT branches to HI-P (high purpose) → SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and to INFO-DS (information dissemination); INFO-DS branches to AFL-DT (affinity dictates) and (C)DEF (the concept of definition).
